business_problem: Lowe's needed to help project-based shoppers, equip store associates with expertise across tens of thousands of items, and modernize store planning across more than 1,750 locations without relying on slow manual planograms, disconnected data, or reactive in-store support.
solution_summary: Lowe's built an AI-first retail stack that combines customer-facing generative AI, computer vision, and digital twins. Mylow uses OpenAI commercial models fine-tuned on Lowe's proprietary data with retrieval-augmented generation and NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails to answer project questions, recommend products, and surface real-time inventory and aisle locations in the app and website. The same generative engine powers the Mylow Companion app for associates. On the operations side, Lowe's runs NVIDIA DeepStream and GPU-based video analytics at store and edge locations so cameras can detect dwell time and notify associates. NVIDIA Omniverse, RTX workstations, the USD Search API, and Hyper3D.ai Rodin support a daily updated digital-twin environment and 30,000-plus-item 3D asset catalog that merchandisers use to simulate layouts, optimize bays, and test localized planograms before making physical changes.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
solution_components.role: Hosts Lowe's store digital-twin workflows and photorealistic simulation environment.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA DeepStream
solution_components.role: Processes in-store video feeds so Lowe's can detect customer dwell events and trigger assistance.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails
solution_components.role: Applies response controls and protections around the Mylow generative AI experience.

solution_components.name: OpenAI commercial models
solution_components.role: Generate project guidance and product recommendations for customer and associate assistants.

solution_components.name: RTX workstations
solution_components.role: Render and simulate digital-twin scenes for the Lowe's Digital Design Center.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA USD Search API
solution_components.role: Indexes and discovers product assets inside the digital-twin content workflow.

solution_components.name: Hyper3D.ai Rodin
solution_components.role: Converts 2D product images into 3D assets for Lowe's catalog.

data_flow: Product, inventory, and proprietary knowledge data feed RAG-backed OpenAI models guarded by NeMo for Mylow and Mylow Companion; camera streams flow through DeepStream at the edge for proactive service; product images and 3D assets flow into Omniverse, USD Search, and Rodin to keep store digital twins and planogram simulations current.
business_outcome: Lowe's reported 98% neutral-to-positive reactions to Mylow, 8,000 AI-assisted engineering code reviews each week, proactive store assistance through computer vision, a 30,000+ item 3D catalog built for less than $1 per model, and digital twins for more than 1,750 stores that make merchandising tests faster and cheaper.
